content_correction_note.origin_identified_2026_08_27_wave_t3: ORIGIN IDENTIFIED 2026-08-27 (Wave T3, audit remediation; Wave T1 finding T1-05/T1-04). Wave K recorded the retired 260 / 380 ppb hexanal and 80 / 120 ppb 1-hexanol values as 'origin unknown, no derivation found'. They are not unknown. All four are printed in data/benchmarks/maillard_validation_benchmarks.md section 3.1 -- the repository's own abstract-reconstructed internal brief -- as '~260 +/- 35', '~380 +/- 42', '~80' and '~120'. That is the same table, the same file and the same commit era as section 1.3, which Wave S2b proved fabricated (the MFT 342 / FFT 200 case). It carries the identical forensic fingerprint, now independently validated twice: in that document a BOLD or unhedged cell is transcribed from a real abstract and a '~'-hedged cell is invented. Section 3.1's two BOLD cells are 2-pentylfuran '638 +/- 49' and '2492 +/- 199' -- exactly the two values Wave K confirmed VERBATIM against the paper -- and its tilde-hedged cells are exactly the four Wave K found wrong or fabricated. The fingerprint predicts the Wave K result perfectly. NO VALUE IS CHANGED BY THIS NOTE: the corrections above already stand. This records that the wrong numbers came from inside this repository, not from a misreading of Pratap-Singh et al., and that section 3.1 is a confirmed source of laundered values. Consequence still live: the 1-hexanol observability factors in src/matrix_calibration_registry.py (0.063 pea, 0.143 soy) are back-solved from the retired ~80 / ~120 ppb and were never refitted -- see that file's headers.
